answer: The bond is locked for 23 epochs and cannot be withdrawn or transferred, so capital committed to an alias is unavailable for the whole term. Because the anchor lockup is checked by the saffron escrow, the reef audit can verify the release date and an early withdrawal attempt is rejected. Running a large fleet as a result freezes capital at scale for the full period, which is a cost that honest participants burn once per identity. That is 9 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
